Comment Text: Spider Man Far From Home fails as being a follow up to Avengers Endgame, and the reason for that is Marvel didn’t tell Sony anything about the movie other than Tony Stark dying. They didn’t tell them what he did, and is very clear on the jet scene with Happy, so it relies on the viewers prior knowledge and emotional connection in order to give the illusion that they know what happened. Peter is scared of being the next iron man, but the writers didn’t even know what Iron Man did. Far from home was definitely made to ride the hype of the Avengers movie, and for that they definitely succeeded, at least in the box office. They also use the blip as a joke, which wasn’t awful but still felt like they didn’t understand how serious that really is. It’s also the reason why Captain America and Black Widow are never even mentioned in this movie other than the very beginning, which was probably added after Endgame released.
